TITLE: freeform-gradient() Editor
SPLINE_NOTE: What WebKit draws. A stiff sheet over the whole plane, through every stop exactly: a formula, with no grid and no edges. Past the stops it keeps going in a straight line.
BIHARMONIC_NOTE: The same stiff sheet cut to the box and solved on a grid: smooth everywhere, overshooting past the stops' colors where it bends, most of all near the edges.
HARMONIC_NOTE: A stretched membrane held at the stops: never overshoots, but creased at each one.
SHEET_NOTE: One component as a height over the box. The thin plate spline is a stiff sheet through the stops that runs on past the box. The biharmonic model is the same sheet ending at the box's edges, and the harmonic model is a membrane pinned at the stops: it rises to a sharp peak or dips to a pit at each one. Drag to turn it.
CSS_INTRO: With the thin plate spline first among the boxes, the freeform-gradient() WebKit takes. With a grid model first, a made-up one.
CSS_GRAMMAR: WebKit's: an interpolation method, unless it's the one WebKit would choose from the colors, then each stop's color, position and, if it has one, / weight. The made-up one names the model, and gives each stop a spread.
